title: Deliver Coal to Finningley Power Station
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Coal** delivered to **Finningley Power Station** (industry id 33, near tile 176,95).

A likely supplier is **Finningley Coal Mine** (industry id 26, near tile 191,86); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **780 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
